label: VERIFIED
extraction: AI Tools for Obsidian: Brings AI agents into Obsidian via Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Supports Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI. 74 stars, Apache-2.0. Features: Parallel sessions (up to 4 side-by-side), message queueing (keep typing while agent responds), quick prompts (saved prompts with @[[wikilinks]] note references), direct agent integration (side panel chat), image attachments, note mention support (active note auto-included). Built on ACP for standardized agent communication. Demo video available.
